title: The Regional Vulnerability Index (RVI) as a Neuroimaging-Based Biomarker for Autism: Associations with Likelihood, Cognition, and Longitudinal Social Outcomes.
abstract: The Regional Vulnerability Index (RVI-ASD) combines ENIGMA-ASD regional effect sizes with COCORO white-matter microstructure to quantify how closely an individual brain resembles the autism pattern. RVI-ASD showed larger case-control effect size (d=0.30) than any single brain measure (N=2,577). In ABCD (N=4,201) it was stable (ICC=0.76-0.92), heritable (h2=0.55-0.83), correlated positively with paternal age, negatively with intelligence, and tracked core autism phenotypes and longitudinal social functioning.
